text:
The median asking rent in the Mettmann district sits at 10.8 €/m² in June 2026, with a year‑on‑year rise of 6.2 % and a five‑year gain of 25.6 %. The 25th‑percentile is 9.38 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 12.02 €/m², placing the district 22nd among the 37 most expensive cities.

Market tightness is evident: properties stay on the market for 29 days and only 24 % are let within a week. Vacancy is low at 1.6 % and the rent‑burden for a two‑person household is 12.5 % of income, while asking rents are about 50 % above the 2022 existing rent of 7.21 €/m².

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 11.31 €/m² in the next 12 months, within a range of 11.0 – 11.56 €/m², implying a further 4.7 % increase.
